xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:OriginalObject: Investment in Related Parties for AMISP projects
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureNotesOnObjectsForWhi: The company in the previous quarters had invested in Gemstar Infra Pte Ltd. (related party) for AMISP project in the form of loan (under loan agreement dated 04th July 2024) as per object stated in the notice to shareholders for EGM. However, due to delay in execution of AMISP projects, the Gemstar Infra Pte Ltd has refunded an amount of INR 38.82 crores (USD 4,535,885) to the Company. Consequently, this amount has been reduced from the total funds utilized as of December 31, 2024, which was INR 203.73 crores. Accordingly, the total fund utilised till March 31, 2025 stand at INR 164.91 crores. Subsequently the same has been invested in FDs along with other unutilized funds.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:OriginalObject: Working capital and other requirements with respect to expanding manufacturing, supply and ancillary services in relation to smart meters.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureNotesOnObjectsForWhi: The actual utilization for General Corporate Purpose (GCP) is INR 20.00 Crs against the INR 19.00 Crs as proposed in the notice to shareholders for EGM. However, the notice to shareholders for EGM also states that "In terms of NSE Notice No. NSE/CML/2022/56 and BSE Notice No. 20221213-47, dated December 13, 2022, the amount specified for the above-mentioned object of issue size may deviate +/-10% depending upon future circumstances". Hence, accordingly as per the required circumstances, company has utilized INR 20.00 Crores instead of INR 19.00 Crores for GCP purpose
